## Hopping Warpriest (CR 4)

**XP** 1200  
 Boggard cleric 1/fighter 1  
 CE Medium humanoid (boggard)  
**Init** +4; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +6  

**Defense**

 **AC** 18, touch 10, flat-footed 18 (+4 armor, +3 natural, +1 shield)  
 **hp** 43 (4d8+1d10+21)  
 **Fort** +9, **Ref** +1, **Will** +5  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 15 ft., **Swim** 20 ft.  
 **Melee** mwk heavy mace +9 (1d8+4), tongue +2 touch (sticky tongue)  
 **Special Attacks** channel negative energy 3/day (DC 10, 1d6), terrifying croak (DC 14)  
 **Domain Spell-Like Abilities** (CL 1st; concentration +3)  

 5/day—touch of chaos  
5/day—icicle (1d6 cold damage)  

 **Spells Prepared** (CL 1st; concentration +3)  

  
  1st—
  *[cure light wounds](../../magic/spells/cure-light-wounds.md)*,
  *[magic weapon](../../magic/spells/magic-weapon.md)*,
  *[obscuring mist](../../magic/spells/obscuring-mist.md)*
  <sup>D</sup>
  

  0 (at will)—
  *[create water](../../magic/spells/create-water.md)*,
  *[resistance](../../magic/spells/resistance.md)*,
  *[virtue](../../magic/spells/virtue.md)*
  

  <sup>D</sup> Domain spell;
  **Domains**
  Chaos,
  Water
  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 19, **Dex** 11, **Con** 18, **Int** 6, **Wis** 14, **Cha** 10  
 **Base Atk** +3; **CMB** +7; **CMD** 17  
 **Feats** Cleave, Elemental Channel (fire), Weapon Focus (heavy mace), [Improved Initiative](../../rules/feats/improved-initiative.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Improved Initiative.*  
 **Skills** Acrobatics –4 (+12 Jump), Craft (sculptures) +2, Knowledge (religion) +3, Perception +0, Stealth –3 (+5 in swamps), Swim +12; Racial Modifiers
